errors.text_span: Диаграмата илюстрира развитието на индекса на електронно правителство (EGDI)
errors.evidence: The chart does not show the EGDI index value itself. Based on the y-axis values (which are counts) and the caption ("Countries with very high EGDI values"), the chart illustrates the number of countries with a high EGDI, not the index value for the regions.
The intervals on the x-axis (years) are not uniform. For example, the gap is one year between 2003 and 2004, but three years between 2005 and 2008.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва стойностите на EGDI
errors.evidence: The vertical axis shows the number of countries, not the EGDI values themselves. The values are integers representing a count.
The fourth series in the legend, representing Eastern Europe (Източна Европа), is colored yellow (жълто), not red (червено).

errors.text_span: Стойността на EGDI за Северна Европа варира от 2 до 8 между годините, с най-ниска стойност през 2003 г. и най-висока през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The values for Northern Europe (blue bars) actually range from 3 (in 2010) to 10 (in 2020). The description reports an incorrect range (2 to 8), an incorrect year for the lowest value (2003, where the value is 5), and an incorrect value and year for the highest value (8 in 2018, when it was 9 in 2018 and peaked at 10 in 2020).

errors.text_span: За Западна Европа стойностите варират от 1 до 9 между годините, с най-ниска стойност през 2003 г.
errors.evidence: The values for Western Europe (orange bars) range from 2 (in 2003 and 2010) to 8 (in 2012 and 2020). The description incorrectly states the range is 1 to 9.

errors.text_span: За Южна Европа стойностите варират от 0 до 6 между годините, с най-ниска стойност през 2003 г. и най-висока през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The values for Southern Europe (grey bars) range from 0 to 7. The description incorrectly states the maximum value is 6 in 2018; the actual maximum is 7 in 2020.
